grammar.label: the colon, the dash and the semicolon at C1 — choosing between them
grammar.form: clause : expansion; clause — interruption or turn; clause ; balanced clause
grammar.meaning: each mark makes a different promise about what follows

explanation.en: B2 taught what each mark does. C1 is about the choice. A colon promises that what follows explains or delivers what preceded. A dash breaks the sentence and is heard as a raised voice, so it works once and tires on the third use. A semicolon balances two clauses of equal weight. The wrong mark is not a typographical slip; it makes the wrong promise.
explanation.uz: B2 darajada har bir belgi nima qilishi o'rgatilgan. C1 — tanlov haqida. Ikki nuqta tushuntirishni va'da qiladi; tire gapni uzadi va ko'tarilgan ovoz kabi eshitiladi; nuqtali vergul teng ikki gapni muvozanatlaydi.

grammar.negative_example: The reason was simple — nobody had been asked to check — and the file stayed — unread.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek va rus tinish belgilari tizimi boshqacha; ikki nuqtaning va'dasi tarjimada yo'qoladi.

grammar.label: ellipsis across sentences and in coordinated structures
grammar.form: leaving out a repeated element the reader can recover from an earlier clause
grammar.meaning: removes what the reader can already supply

explanation.en: 'She read the first report; he, the second.' The verb is gone and nobody misses it. Ellipsis works only when the recovered element is identical in form, not merely in sense: 'She has read it and he will' fails, because 'read' and 'read' are different forms there. That test — identical form, not identical meaning — is the whole rule.
explanation.uz: 'She read the first report; he, the second.' Fe'l yo'q va hech kim uni sog'inmaydi. Ellipsis faqat tiklanadigan qism SHAKLAN bir xil bo'lgandagina ishlaydi, ma'nan emas.

grammar.positive_example: The first inspection found nothing; the second, a crack two metres long.
grammar.negative_example: The first inspection found nothing; the second, a crack and it was two metres long.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida takroriy qism tushirilishi odatiy; ingliz tilidagi shakl bir xilligi sharti yangi.
